paper_metadata.title: Hybrid Quantum–Classical Learning Approaches for Scalable Optimization Beyond NISQ Limitations

summary: The paper proposes a hybrid PQC-based framework (HQC‑MLF) evaluated in noisy simulation with 8–16 qubits and circuit depth 2–10. The method converges in 142 iterations versus 175 for QAOA and 210–280 for classical baselines, and achieves solution scores of 0.92 (routing), 0.90 (portfolio), and 0.91 (energy) while reducing average circuit depth from 8 (QAOA) to 6.

experiments.description: Hybrid quantum-classical optimization framework (HQC-MLF) evaluated on logistics routing, portfolio optimization, and energy load balancing using parameterized quantum circuits with classical optimization and noise mitigation in simulation.

algorithm.variant: Hybrid Quantum–Classical Machine Learning Framework (HQC-MLF) with adaptive ansatz selection
algorithm.ansatz: parameterized quantum circuits (PQC); specific ansatz not named
algorithm.convergence_criteria: until convergence / stable solution; exact stopping rule not specified

problem_formulation.encoding_details: classical preprocessing and feature encoding into PQC inputs; exact qubit-to-variable mapping not specified
problem_formulation.objective_function: minimize optimization objective L(θ)=⟨ψ(θ)|H|ψ(θ)⟩ with hybrid update θ_{t+1}=θ_t−η∇_θL(θ_t)
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: adaptive ansatz selection, error mitigation, and resource-aware scheduling; no explicit penalty formulation reported
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: H in expectation value ⟨ψ(θ)|H|ψ(θ)⟩; explicit Hamiltonian not given

problem_instance.description: Benchmark applications in logistics routing, portfolio optimization, and energy load balancing
problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: classical preprocessing and feature encoding; no further details reported
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: comparison against classical gradient descent, reinforcement learning, and QAOA baseline; metrics include convergence speed, solution quality, approximation ratio, circuit depth efficiency, and energy usage

noise_model.error_mitigation_method: zero-noise extrapolation, measurement error correction, parameter-shift rule optimization

implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: post-processing and decision module interprets optimized results

convergence_data.loss_curve_shape: decreasing loss with faster convergence than baselines

speedup_claims.conditions: under realistic NISQ simulations across logistics routing, portfolio optimization, and energy load balancing
speedup_claims.caveats: The paper reports empirical improvement in iterations to converge (142 vs 175/210/280) but does not provide asymptotic complexity or a proven quantum speedup.
